claim_scope: Source-check and continuation observations; repeated symptoms are not independent defects.
cohort_scope: Additional exposed provider-recovery cohort; distinct from both the original and incomplete corrected collection.
interpretation: Assigned-component check signals only. Shared verification is reported separately and earns no channel-exclusive credit. Unknown, unavailable and rejected outcomes retain separate categories. Timings remain source/host strata and are not an efficacy comparison.
